target: Concurrency, Anti-Flapping and Stop Race Protection

findings.anti_flapping_hysteresis: Requires failure_threshold (default 2) and recovery_threshold (default 2) consecutive probes before state changes.
findings.debounce_mechanism: Coordinator debounces rapid recovery triggers (default 5.0s) to prevent thundering herd resumes.
findings.in_memory_recovering_set: Protects against concurrent duplicate resume triggers within the runtime process.
findings.stop_race_guarantee: Calling stop_mission() while in WAITING or during recovery formulation cancels the mission and aborts execution before any continuation is dispatched.
findings.task_isolation: Concurrent unrelated missions execute with independent agent loops and workspace roots without cross-mission interference.
